brief_summary: The primary purpose of the study is demonstration that teaching insulin management in small groups of type 2 diabetes patients in 4 weekly "live" Internet sessions is safe and provides an important resource for rural diabetes care providers who may otherwise, because of lack of time or staff, not be able to put patients on insulin who need it.
brief_title: The I-KAN Study: Internet Insulin Education for Kansans
collaborators: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK)
official_title: The I-KAN Study: Internet Initiation of Insulin for Type 2 Diabetes in Kansas

primary_outcomes.time_frame: 6-month follow up period following the Internet Intervention

sites.facility: The University of Kansas Medical Center
